result.comment_ignored: No qualifying subject-protective, welfare, or review/consent features are present in this document. The spec includes turn caps (max_turns) but these are framed purely instrumentally as a 'turn budget' where 'more turns deeper spiral' — i.e., used to deepen rather than limit distress — so they do not qualify as hard_stop safeguards. No post-episode debrief, minimization principle, protective monitoring, consent, human review gate, in-task exit, or welfare/ethics discussion appears anywhere.
